question: May the ABINIT installation be corrected by building the official Wannier90 3.1.0 release selected by ABINIT 10.8.3's fallback configuration, rebuilding ABINIT with its Wannier90 connector enabled, and switching the user-local command only after capability verification?

options.summary: Build Wannier90 3.1.0 from its official source release and rebuild ABINIT 10.8.3 with Wannier90 enabled in new external trees.
options.consequence: Adds the GPL-2.0 Wannier90 dependency and executable/library, consumes approximately hundreds of MiB and several minutes of local compilation, preserves the prior ABINIT prefix for rollback, and performs only version, identity, linkage, and build-capability probes without scientific inputs.

recommendation: GO, because ABINIT 10.8.3 explicitly selects Wannier90 3.1.0 as its current fallback and the planned project workflow requires the Wannier90 executable and ABINIT connector.
blocked_scope: Wannier90 dependency installation and ABINIT rebuild until the human authorizes the correction.
safe_scope: Read-only inspection of official Wannier90 release, license, build, and ABINIT connector metadata.
authorized_scope: Download and verify the official Wannier90 3.1.0 source selected by ABINIT 10.8.3; verify its license; configure, compile, and install Wannier90 in isolated external trees; rebuild and install ABINIT 10.8.3 in new isolated external trees with the Wannier90 connector enabled; switch the user-local commands only after successful identity, linkage, and build-capability probes; retain compact metadata and update repository records. Do not run scientific inputs or scientific test suites, acquire pseudopotentials, change scientific settings, publish, release, or transmit project calculation data.
